Warrant Officer '''Urman Nakk''' was a security [[Officer/Legends|officer]] for the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] around the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. On duty when [[Tam Elgrin]] warned of a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Spy/Legends|infiltrator]], Nakk did not believe the warning.
